system.description:
Master of hellfire and unbreakable contracts. More dangerous to cross than to serve.

  • Dark Gift (1st): For 1 Patron Favour, once per round, out of turn, when a creature damages you, it takes 2d10 fire damage, +1d10 per 6 Warlock levels. No saving throw.
  • Patron's Mark (4th): For 1 Patron Favour, speak a statement of 10 words or fewer that becomes magically binding on you: if you break it you take 2d6 fire damage. A creature that witnesses the oath and breaks a deal made in that moment takes 2d6 fire damage.
  • Patron Feature (8th): For 1 Patron Favour, bind a creature to a spoken contract (Will save against your Class Save DC). Breaking it deals 4d6 fire and marks them — other devils will pursue the oathbreaker.

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Mephistopheles in the World of Arneyan wiki.
